rightsBasis: Oslo kommune states that digitized Oslo byarkiv photographs are free to use for any purpose in the resolution available for download at DigitaltMuseum or Oslobilder; mandatory credit and respect for privacy/moral rights. This is a use-policy basis, NOT an invented Creative Commons version.
reviewNeeded: Locate actual downloadable photo on Oslobilder or DigitaltMuseum for this exact archivalIdentifier
Compare photographic subject to catalog title, object type and year
Record downloaded file SHA-256, dimensions and correct attribution
Verify source institution's terms apply to the chosen downloaded resolution and preserve image integrity
Stage as noncropped candidate in a separate directory
Test PlaceCard Objects layout on 390px and desktop; ensure visible photo credit and source link
Obtain editorial source-fidelity approval before replacing any canonical image path
